The '''Marasaln system''' was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Outer Jalor sector/Legends|Outer Jalor sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Marasaln Conflict]],<ref name="Death Star Coup">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2014|A Certain Point of View|A Certain Point of View: The Death Star Coup}}</ref> which was fought at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2014|A Certain Point of View|A Certain Point of View: The Death Star Coup}} states that [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]] participated in the [[Marasaln Conflict]] at some point after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and {{DB|character|generaltagge|Tagge, General}} establishes Tagge [[Death/Legends|died]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Order|end]] of the Clone Wars and the Battle of Yavin to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], respectively.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Marasaln [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square I-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
